wizard.step1_desc: Select a recipe or formulate an ad-hoc batch.
wizard.step2_desc: Assign your boiler and fermentation vessel.
wizard.step3_desc: Review targets and record brew day initial parameters.
wizard.strike_temp_help: Target strike temperature for mash rest at {targetTemp}.
wizard.sparge_temp_help: Target sparge water temperature for lautering at {targetTemp}.
wizard.no_sparge_biab_help: All water is used for mashing. Sparge water heating not required.
wizard.water_info_intro: The system works backwards from your desired final volume, adding equipment losses at each brewing stage to determine how much water you need at the start.
wizard.water_info_total_water: The total amount of brewing water you need to heat and prepare for the entire brew day. This is the sum of strike water and sparge water.
wizard.water_info_strike_water: The water added to the mash tun together with your grain at the start of mashing. Volume is determined by the water-to-grain ratio (typically 2.5–4 L/kg).
wizard.water_info_sparge_water: Hot water rinsed through the grain bed after mashing to extract remaining sugars and reach the target pre-boil volume in the kettle.
wizard.water_info_grain_absorption: The water absorbed and retained by the malt during the mash (~0.96 L/kg of grain) that is not drained into the kettle.
wizard.water_info_pre_boil: The cold-equivalent wort volume in the kettle just before the boil begins — after mashing, lautering, and sparging are complete.
wizard.water_info_post_boil: The cooled wort volume remaining after the boil, accounting for evaporation (boil-off) and thermal shrinkage during chilling (~4%).
wizard.water_info_into_fermenter: The wort volume transferred into your fermentation vessel after leaving behind kettle trub (hop debris and hot break sediment).
wizard.water_info_packaged: The final beer volume that ends up in bottles, cans, or kegs — after subtracting yeast cake (trub) and packaging transfer losses from the fermenter.
wizard.sparge_enabled_help: Uncheck for no-sparge or BIAB (Brew In A Bag). All water will be used as strike water.
wizard.equipment_losses_desc: Default losses are loaded from your selected equipment profile. You can override them for this batch if conditions deviate.
